fields.name: FiftySixDaysRuleViolated

There are {!Check_if_56_Days_Rule_is_Violated.varCountOfMatchingRecords} existing opportunities for this account that are within 56 days of the Drive Date {!Drive_Date}.


  1. Click Next to continue creating the Opportunity record accepting the 56 day rule violation or,
  2. Click Previous to go back and enter another Drive Date.
